items.title: Local shift under the mucosa (L1)
items.text: One area (L1, 16 windows of 200 um, from the submucosa down into the muscularis) has cells off their nuclei by a median 7.5 um (up to 17.8 um, toward the upper right), while the rest of the section sits on its nuclei (median 1 um) and the global affine needs no change. The local correction moves cells by at most 16.3 um; measured again after it, 0 of the 16 windows remain off. Apply the local correction.

check.reason: Real local shift: cyan cells sit beside the nuclei in the L1 close-up, yellow (corrected) on them; correction verified by re-measurement.
check.evidence: check_registration_map: L1 16 windows, median 7.5 um / max 17.8 um off, affine part identity; after the local correction windows_off_after 0, median 1.0 um, no false readings.
